text:
maria: FYI canary rollout 2026-03-17/12:03 — p99 latency jumped ~12% after merge of PR #4123
raj: saw that in perf CI too, link: https://ci.redwood/pipeline/987/perf
perf-ci-bot: PERF CHECK FAILED — p95 +8% p99 +13% vs baseline (ref run 1824900000)
sam: rollback pause? we should stop further traffic to canary
deploy-bot: Canary traffic scaled to 0% for model-r2 in region-us-west-2 — action by @sam :rotating_light:
maria: logs show lots of KV cache churn, miss rate spiked from 2% -> 18%
raj: relevant merge touched kernel selection heuristics + kv cache TTL change (PR #4123)
olivia: can you paste the diff or commits?
raj: commit 9f4a2b3: kernel: prefer-algo B when seq_len>128
raj: commit a7c9f11: kv: default ttl 1s -> 0.1s (debug setting leaked)
sam: that TTL change could explain churn. KV misses cause more attention recompute => higher tail
maria: profiler snapshot attached:
```
--- top frame counts ---
attention_kernel_B: 54.3%
attention_kernel_A: 21.1%
kv_fetch: 13.7%
memcopy: 5.2%
```
raj: interesting, kernel B is faster for long sequences but has worse warmup for KV interleaving
maria: also seeing an uptick in context-switch in runtime logs:
`runtime: batch_wait 0.9ms -> 8.2ms under canary`
sam: proposal: revert the TTL change immediately and pause kernel-auto-select, pin to kernel A for canary
olivia: agree. can we do a targeted rollback for only the kv TTL commit? easier than full revert
maria: I can ship a cherry-pick revert for a7c9f11 now
perf-ci-bot: quick perf check queued: job 1002
raj: also want a bisect to confirm which commit causes the regression. I'll run bisect across last 5 merges
sam: @deploy-bot can you keep canary paused until we have perf green? :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary remains at 0% until explicit resume by an owner
perf-ci-bot: job 1002 result: p99 back to baseline after TTL revert candidate
maria: great — this suggests kv TTL was the main culprit
raj: bisect run narrowed to commit a7c9f11, confident
sam: ok let's merge the TTL revert (cherry-pick 5b6d7c) and unpause canary gradually with SLO guard
maria: rolling out revert to canary now; will enable SLO gate: abort if p99 > baseline+5%
deploy-bot: Canary ramp 0% -> 30% over 15m with SLO guard
olivia: monitor logs and kv miss rate
maria: early numbers look good, p99 stable, kv miss down to 3%
raj: follow-up: add test to CI to catch kv ttl regressions and add canary metric guard for kv_miss>5%
sam: assigning @raj to add CI test, @maria to write postmortem blurb
maria: will send short thread to #incidents and add to canary runbook
olivia: thanks all — nice quick loop :tada:
